Manage an LLM wiki: schema-enforced writes, hybrid search, sync

Usage:
  canopy [command]

Available Commands:
  archive     Move a superseded page to _archive/ (inbound wikilinks become plain text)
  backlinks   Show pages linking to a page, or list orphans with --orphans
  bridge      Find similar page pairs: unlinked = connection candidates; --include-linked adds merge/contradiction candidates
  checkin     Validate the working copy (schema, mermaid, base conflict) and write it into the wiki
  checkout    Materialize a working copy for native editing (outside the wiki; checkin brings it back)
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  digest      Collect review material for a window: created/updated pages, tags, decision timeline
  events      Query the machine-local event log (attention + task/sync/reconcile lifecycle)
  grep        Regexp search with line numbers (slug:line: text) — across the wiki or inside one page
  help        Help about any command
  init        Adopt a wiki: write canopy.toml (schema) and build the index cache
  lint        Check schema compliance, links, staleness (report only for now)
  list        List all pages (slug, type, title), filterable by --type / --tag
  migrate     Apply pending data-state migrations (also runs automatically on first use)
  model       Manage the local embedding model
  mv          Move a page between categories and/or rename it (rewrites inbound wikilinks)
  new         Create a schema-validated page (index/log/embedding handled automatically)
  recall      Chunk-level evidence for a question (agent memory: verbatim chunks + source slugs)
  reconcile   Report back-door changes the blessed ledger doesn't know (read-only)
  reindex     Rebuild the derived index (pages, FTS, and embeddings)
  resurface   Pick forgotten/stale-hub pages to re-encounter (records pick history)
  rm          Delete a page (refuses when backlinks exist, unless --force)
  search      Search the wiki (hybrid = BM25 keyword + semantic vectors)
  serve       Serve the wiki as a website (search, browsing, and edit proposals)
  show        Print a page — whole, --lines N-M, or --section "heading" (path header on stderr)
  skills      Manage the agent skill set for this wiki (hermes, Claude Code, …)
  status      Wiki health at a glance: pages, git state, index freshness
  sync        pull --rebase → commit all wiki changes → push → refresh index
  tags        Show the valid types and tag taxonomy; --audit measures usage
  tasks       Delegated task queue (web → agent): list, add, done (verified), dismiss
  update      Record an edit: bump updated date, optionally replace the body, reindex + log
  version     Print version, build metadata, and the data-schema version

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for canopy
      --json          machine-readable JSON output
  -v, --version       version for canopy
      --wiki string   wiki root (default: $CANOPY_WIKI or canopy.toml discovery)

Use "canopy [command] --help" for more information about a command.
